meta.name: Life Ledger 2.0 — Today View Direction Design DNA
meta.description: Visual and interaction DNA extracted from the primary reference (en-01-today-planning-v2.png) and applied across three distinct architectural variants (Luminous Daily Canvas, Orbit Desk, Editorial Bento) at 1440×900 Mac window resolution. Resolves the stark failure of phase-3-5-1 by restoring atmospheric depth, dark emerald anchor surfaces, tactile island cards, organic bubble silhouettes, rich habit iconography, luminous focus islands, and calm pointer-aware physics.

color.palette_type: deep emerald anchor foundation paired with warm luminous parchment, serene sage, sky, coral and amber accents

primary.role: deep ink, primary typography, and dark anchor card surfaces

secondary.role: signature Life Ledger sage, completion states, active indicators, and organic accents

accent.role: warm coral highlight for energy, exercise, and active focus state

neutral.usage: warm parchment canvas, soft elevated cards, subtle borders, secondary labels, and deep ink typography

reading.label: Reading
reading.role: warm golden amber, knowledge and literary pacing

meditation.label: Meditation
meditation.role: serene orchid lavender, mindfulness and breath

deep_work.label: Deep Work
deep_work.role: grounded forest emerald, sustained intellectual flow

color.contrast_strategy: dark-emerald anchor cards anchor visual mass; warm parchment canvas relieves eye strain; luminous mint focus island highlights intentional action; habit colors provide immediate distinct identification without sensory overload

font_families.heading: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'PingFang SC', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif
font_families.body: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'PingFang SC', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif
font_families.mono: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, ui-monospace, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: Native macOS system stack avoids any remote font requests; high editorial weight contrast between bold dates/quotes and quiet metadata; tabular numerals enabled for timers and progress metrics.

spacing.content_density: high spatial efficiency calibrated for complete zero-scroll containment at 1440×900 viewport
spacing.section_rhythm: 6–10px inside compact controls, 14–18px inside island cards, 12–16px between functional grid modules

layout.grid_system: adaptive 1440×900 desktop canvas with modular pane constraints
layout.columns: sidebar 216–236px; primary work canvas 1204–1224px divided by variant architecture
layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric dynamic balance with strong focal anchors rather than uniform repetitive cards

shape.border_usage: 1px hairline tonal borders with subtle rgba opacity matching canvas warmth; avoids harsh bounding boxes
shape.divider_style: semi-transparent tonal dividers and soft card spacing rather than heavy horizontal rules

elevation.shadow_style: layered multi-stop ambient diffusion with tonal warmth; no harsh black drop-shadows
elevation.depth_cues: dark emerald anchors recess in perceived depth while light floating bubble cards advance forward; translucent glowing arcs provide celestial layering

iconography.style: clean, modern, human-centric SVG line symbols with 1.8px consistent stroke and rounded joins
iconography.preferred_set: bespoke inline SVG set matching the reference aesthetic

motion.entrance_pattern: opacity and scale(0.98 -> 1) emerging along natural optical flow
motion.philosophy: dynamic feedback is causal, instantaneous, and settled; never perpetual amusement or distracting continuous loops; transforms and opacities only
motion.reduced_motion_behavior: collapses transform/motion durations to 0s while preserving instantaneous color, background, border, and state feedback

components.button_style: tactile rounded pills with 0.97 active press scale, subtle hover luminescence, and 2px high-visibility focus ring
components.input_style: borderless on writing sheets until focused; clear 1px tonal boundary on focus with soft inner glow
components.card_style: floating island cards with organic bubble corner motifs, layered soft shadows, and subtle pointer-following specular gleam
components.navigation_pattern: macOS dark emerald floating sidebar with active indicator highlight, collapse control, and stoic quote footer
components.modal_style: not present in normal-mode Today viewport; prototype uses floating detached bottom switcher
components.list_style: icon-first interactive horizontal rails and modular bento tiles
components.habit_rail_style: horizontal rail where each habit card displays its own color badge, inline SVG icon, title, target, checkmark button, and reorders to the collection end on completion
components.focus_island_style: luminous pale mint surface with circular progress ring, large tabular timer numerals, preset tags, and Start/Pause toggle
components.prototype_switcher_style: floating glass pill anchored at bottom center, visually isolated from app UI, supporting mouse click and keyboard arrow navigation
components.component_notes: All interactive states are keyboard accessible and have dedicated hover, focus, and press treatments. Today is a user-composable widget canvas: widgets snap to S/M/L sizes, can be reordered, hidden, and restored; the habit rail exposes explicit 4/8-card capacity rather than freeform resizing.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: an illuminated personal desk at dawn, combining dark grounding leather anchors with luminous parchment and organic instruments
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary high-end macOS application blending Swiss editorial craft with Scandinavian organic warmth
aesthetic.genre: personal mindful productivity and reflective analytics

visual_language.ornamentation: subtle organic bubble cutouts, glowing concentric arcs, and delicate habit badges; zero gratuitous skeuomorphism
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous breathing room calibrated to eliminate dead grey zones while fitting comfortably in 900px height
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: 60% anchor surfaces (cinematic day hero & focus island), 25% habit rhythm, 15% reflection & memory
visual_language.focal_strategy: tri-anchor hierarchy: dark cinematic hero establishes day context; horizontal habit rail provides immediate somatic momentum; luminous focus island invites deep flow
visual_language.contrast_level: rich dynamic range from deep emerald (#17231E) to crisp elevated white (#FFFFFF) against warm parchment (#F4F1EA)
visual_language.texture_usage: translucent concentric geometric arcs, smooth specular spotlight, and soft layered Gaussian blurs

composition.hierarchy_method: scale, tonal contrast, spatial isolation, and color luminance
composition.balance_type: dynamic asymmetry anchored by dark emerald focal cards
composition.flow_direction: sidebar navigation → top day anchor & mood → horizontal habit foundation → focus action & reflection
composition.grouping_strategy: spatial clusters grouped by daily intent (orientation, physical/mental foundations, focused work, mindful reflection)
composition.negative_space_role: serves as breathing room that guides optical flow and separates cognitive modes

variant_comparisons.variant_a: Luminous Daily Canvas: dark emerald sidebar, wide cinematic day hero with layered arcs and progress ring, asymmetric mood/memory card, a 4/8-capacity habit rail, and a composable widget board where Focus, Reflection, Weather, and Calendar snap to S/M/L sizes and can be reordered, hidden, or restored.
variant_comparisons.variant_b: Orbit Desk: central day/progress core with surrounding satellite bubbles (mood, memory, focus, reflection) connected by an icon orbit rail; tactile and organic yet strictly utilitarian.
variant_comparisons.variant_c: Editorial Bento: split composition with a narrow date/narrative journal column on the left and an irregular bento workspace on the right, pairing a dark hero tile with varied-span habit bento modules and an airy focus zone.

imagery.photo_treatment: warm personal memory frame with 14px border radius, subtle inner shadow, and contextual time caption
imagery.illustration_style: bespoke project-owned inline SVG line art depicting a calm autumn studio window with morning tea and notebook; zero stock photography
imagery.graphic_elements: circular progress rings with stroke dashes, layered translucent concentric arcs, organic corner bubble shapes, and habit status badges
imagery.pattern_usage: none; clean solid and tonal gradient fills only
imagery.image_shape: rounded rectangles with 14px corner radius and smooth organic bubble accents

interaction_feel.feedback_style: instant tactile response (0.97 scale on active press), spring settling on habit check, and smooth FLIP reordering
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: subtle 1–4px surface lift, smooth shadow bloom, and pointer-following specular light highlight
interaction_feel.transition_personality: snappy, responsive, with organic settling easing; no stiff linear transitions
interaction_feel.loading_style: stable geometry reservation with instantaneous offline prototype rendering
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: high quality, calm execution across every button, habit card, mood selector, and timer control

brand_voice_in_ui.formality: approachable professional with quiet literary grace
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: short, affirmative verbs: 'Start focus', 'Pause focus', 'Adjust goals →'
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: constructive invitations with soothing imagery and actionable hints

overview.effect_intensity: refined atmospheric glow and pointer spotlight
overview.performance_tier: hardware-accelerated CSS transforms and opacity only
overview.fallback_strategy: instantaneous state updates with zero loss of layout or functionality when motion is reduced
overview.primary_technology: vanilla CSS custom properties, SVG graphics, and lightweight vanilla DOM scripts

background_effects.type: subtle radial spotlight and layered tonal gradients
background_effects.description: Interactive pointer-aware specular highlight tracks cursor position over surface cards; subtle concentric arcs glow behind the dark hero
background_effects.technology: CSS radial-gradient with --mouse-x and --mouse-y CSS variables

particle_systems.description: No distracting particles; preserves quiet desktop focus

3d_elements.description: Subtle 1–4px lift and gentle 1–1.5deg perspective tilt on interactive cards for pointer-fine devices

shader_effects.description: No WebGL shaders required; purely lightweight CSS rendering

scroll_morphing.description: Completely zero-scroll viewport at 1440×900 Mac window resolution

text_effects.description: Focus timer numbers use monospace tabular figures to eliminate layout jitter during countdown; status labels crossfade smoothly
text_effects.technology: CSS font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and opacity transitions

cursor_effects.description: Native macOS cursor is preserved with standard pointer/text affordances

image_effects.description: Photo memory illustration subtly warms with gentle 1.02 scale and subtle border glow on hover

glassmorphism_neumorphism.style: frosted prototype switcher pill and floating card overlays

canvas_drawings.description: All progress rings and charts rendered using vector SVGs for crisp HiDPI Retina fidelity

svg_animations.description: Checkmark stroke draws dynamically upon habit completion; progress ring circumference updates smoothly; active focus ring pulses gently when running

visual_effects.composite_notes: The DNA unifies all three variants under a single cohesive aesthetic truth: life planning is an intimate, serene practice that demands deep visual warmth, grounded tactile depth, and delightful momentum—banishing the sterile grey administrative dashboard forever.
